objective: A burst of credential attempts is refused, and the refusals are recorded as a security event rather than as ordinary traffic
preconditions: the sign-in rate limit is configured
this test exhausts the credential rate-limit budget for its address; newTenant retries on 429 so a later suite is not stranded by it
input: Twenty sign-in attempts in a row, then the API log
expected: The budget is exhausted and the refusals appear at warning level, named as the rate limiter and as a credential endpoint
detail: 19 of 20 attempt(s) refused with 429; 19 limiter line(s) written — 19 at warning level, 19 named as a credential endpoint, 19 attributed to the limiter
